canonical_project: darya.ai Darvoz Green AI Data Center (Area AI technopark / National AI Cluster)
notes: Tajikistan's (and Central Asia's) first green AI compute data center, located in Darvoz district of the Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Region (GBAO). The country's first NVIDIA H200 GPU cluster was inaugurated on 25 June 2025 under the patronage of President Emomali Rahmon; the site also hosts the National AI Cluster and the 'Area AI' technopark built by darya.ai. Powered by renewable hydropower. Per company statements the facility initially offers ~2 MW of power capacity with expansion to 100 MW planned in future phases.
